name: Ultra Ball
whenGood: Core consistency for every Evolution deck.
whenBrick: Costs two discards — painful when hand is thin.

name: Nest Ball
whenGood: Sets up Bench early without discarding.
whenBrick: Bricks mid/late when Bench is full or Basics are gone.

name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
whenGood: Best early Bench loader for 70 HP Basics.
whenBrick: Dead if no low-HP Basics left or Bench is full.

name: Rare Candy
whenGood: Turns on Stage 2 attackers one turn earlier.
whenBrick: Dead without matching Basic + Stage 2 in hand.

name: Boss's Orders
whenGood: Prize mapping and KO sequencing.
whenBrick: Wasted without a KO follow-up or when Bench is empty.

name: Counter Catcher
whenGood: Comeback gust when behind on prizes.
whenBrick: Illegal / blank when ahead or tied on prizes.

name: Iono
whenGood: Refills your hand and wrecks theirs mid-game.
whenBrick: Can refill an opponent who was bricked.

name: Professor's Research
whenGood: Raw redraw when the hand is disposable.
whenBrick: Discards key pieces you still needed.

name: Arven
whenGood: Fetches ACE SPEC / Tool + consistency Item in one supporter.
whenBrick: Soft if you need draw more than tutor.

name: Crispin
whenGood: Dual-type ramp for Dragapult / multi-energy attackers.
whenBrick: Blank if you only run one Energy type.

name: Night Stretcher
whenGood: Recovers discarded attackers and Energy.
whenBrick: Dead if discard is empty of targets.

name: Earthen Vessel
whenGood: Fast Energy tutor after a discard.
whenBrick: Needs a discardable card in hand.

name: Super Rod
whenGood: Recycles prized/discarded resources for long games.
whenBrick: Slow when you need immediate hand cards.

name: Switch
whenGood: Retreat without paying Energy; pivots into attackers.
whenBrick: Dead with empty Bench.

name: Pokégear 3.0
whenGood: Finds Boss/Iono/Research on curve.
whenBrick: Misses if Supporters are deep or already in hand.

name: Poké Ball
whenGood: Budget Pokémon search when Ultra Ball density is low.
whenBrick: 50% miss rate — unreliable.

name: Energy Switch
whenGood: Repositions Energy after KOs or onto a fresh attacker.
whenBrick: Dead without Energy on board.

name: Crushing Hammer
whenGood: Slows single-Energy attackers and Tools-on-Energy lines.
whenBrick: Coin-flip Item — often a brick.

name: Unfair Stamp
whenGood: Locks Item-heavy decks after a decisive KO turn.
whenBrick: Soft vs decks that do not lean on Items.

name: Secret Box
whenGood: One-card toolbox grab for combo turns.
whenBrick: Costs 3 discards — catastrophic on thin hands.

name: Fezandipiti ex
whenGood: Format draw engine once damaged; snipes Bench.
whenBrick: Needs damage on itself and Psychic Energy for attack.

name: Munkidori
whenGood: Moves chip damage onto KO ranges for Dragapult lines.
whenBrick: Needs damage on itself and setup space.

name: Dreepy
whenGood: Poffin target into Dragapult.
whenBrick: Dead late without Rare Candy / Stage pieces.

name: Drakloak
whenGood: Filter draw while climbing into Dragapult.
whenBrick: Often skipped with Rare Candy.

name: Dragapult ex
whenGood: Spread-then-snipe with Boss/Counter Catcher closes games.
whenBrick: Loses to faster single-prize pressure and rough Psychic techs.

name: Dipplin
whenGood: Enables Festival Grounds loop with Thwackey/Seaking.
whenBrick: Needs Stadium lock and Applin setup.

name: Applin
whenGood: Into Dipplin for Festival Lead.
whenBrick: Tiny HP — easy KO before evolution.

name: Thwackey
whenGood: Second Festival Lead body for Stadium loop.
whenBrick: Needs Grookey and Stadium.

name: Grookey
whenGood: Poffinable into Thwackey.
whenBrick: Without evolution it's a weak Basic.

name: Seaking
whenGood: Stadium-on payoff attacker for Festival Lead.
whenBrick: Blank without Festival Grounds.

name: Goldeen
whenGood: Into Seaking for Festival.
whenBrick: Low impact alone.

name: Festival Grounds
whenGood: Turns on Festival Lead cost reduction and bulk.
whenBrick: Shared — opponent Festival pieces also benefit.

name: Lacey
whenGood: Late-game Festival / combo redraw.
whenBrick: Weak early when prizes are high.

name: Duskull
whenGood: Into Dusknoir for Cursed Blast KO help.
whenBrick: Dead draw without Stage 2 package.

name: Dusclops
whenGood: Bridge into Dusknoir.
whenBrick: Often Candied past.

name: Dusknoir
whenGood: Sacrificial KO enabler with Dragapult spread.
whenBrick: Self-KO costs a prize — timing matters.

name: Torchic
whenGood: Into Blaziken ex Fire partner package.
whenBrick: Off-type in pure Psychic Dragapult.

name: Combusken
whenGood: Bridge to Blaziken ex.
whenBrick: Skipped with Rare Candy.

name: Blaziken ex
whenGood: Bench pressure partner for Dragapult variants.
whenBrick: Needs Fire Energy and Candy; prized Torchic hurts.

name: Drilbur
whenGood: Into Mega Excadrill ex.
whenBrick: High retreat for a Basic.

name: Excadrill
whenGood: Bridge / backup before Mega Evolution.
whenBrick: Outclassed once Mega Excadrill is online.

name: Mega Excadrill ex
whenGood: High HP tank that closes 2-prizes cleanly.
whenBrick: Self-Bench damage and Grass Weakness.

name: N's Zorua
whenGood: N's lineage into Zoroark ex.
whenBrick: Needs N's Zoroark specifically.

name: N's Zoroark ex
whenGood: Trade engine plus hand disruption closer.
whenBrick: Trade discards precious pieces; Grass Weakness.

name: N's Plan
whenGood: Synergizes with N's Pokémon disruption plans.
whenBrick: Competes with Iono/Research for supporter slot.

name: Cleffa
whenGood: Free retreat draw Baby for box shells.
whenBrick: 30 HP — dies to any chip.

name: Clefairy
whenGood: Box enabler that tutors diverse Basics.
whenBrick: Metronome needs a useful opposing attack.

name: Clefable ex
whenGood: Flexible closer for Clefairy box shells.
whenBrick: Metal Weakness and Stage 1 tempo.

name: Gastly

whenBrick: Fragile Basic.

name: Haunter
whenGood: Bridge to Mega Gengar.
whenBrick: Often Candied past.

name: Mega Gengar ex
whenGood: Pivot pressure plus sleep disruption.
whenBrick: Stage 2 Mega ramp; Darkness Weakness.

name: Charmander
whenGood: Into Mega Charizard Y ex stub line.
whenBrick: Self-discard on attack.

name: Charmeleon
whenGood: Bridge to Mega Charizard Y.
whenBrick: Candied past in dedicated builds.

name: Mega Charizard Y ex
whenGood: High ceiling Fire Mega attacker.
whenBrick: Energy hungry; Water Weakness.

name: Iron Hands ex
whenGood: Prize-positive closer vs single-prize lines.
whenBrick: High retreat; Fighting Weakness.

name: Heavy Baton
whenGood: Energy transfer on KO for tanky Basics.
whenBrick: Blank on low-retreat attackers.

name: Terapagos ex
whenGood: Ability-heavy Bench payoff.
whenBrick: Needs populated Ability Bench.

name: Pikachu ex
whenGood: Bench-count aggro.
whenBrick: Falls off vs gust and spread.

name: Eevee

whenBrick: Without Eeveelutions it's filler.

name: Sylveon ex
whenGood: Psychic attach support for Dragapult-adjacent shells.
whenBrick: Competes for Bench and Energy.

name: Lillie's Clefairy ex

name: Lillie

name: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex

whenBrick: Soft vs thin hands.

name: Zekrom ex

name: Black Bolt Badge

name: Reshiram ex

name: White Flare Badge

name: Phantom Arena

name: Hero's Bond

name: Order Tablet

name: Perfect Order Rotom
whenGood: Item filter for toolbox decks.
whenBrick: Low HP Basic.

name: Pecharunt ex

whenBrick: Self-Poison and Fighting Weakness.

name: Mega Ring
whenGood: Bulk for Mega Excadrill / Mega Gengar.
whenBrick: Blank on non-Mega attackers.

name: Artazon
whenGood: Shared Basic setup Stadium.

name: Briar
